name: GLab
description: GLab Ent. is Guang’s Udyam-registered sole proprietorship for developing and presenting practical technology products. GLab also publishes project notes, technical articles, and learning records.

intro: GLab is my enterprise for building and presenting practical technology projects. Its work includes GLabNetOps, a network-operations product, alongside other software and technical initiatives.

This site also serves as my project lab and writing space: I share how the work began, what I learned, and what is ready to demonstrate. Growing up in the hills of Manipur shaped my interest in nature, environmental sustainability, and locally suitable sustainable farming practices.
profile.statement: I’m passionate about building a future where technology and nature coexist harmoniously.
profile.workLine: Technology products and projects developed through GLab Ent.
profile.interestLine: Building practical systems with care for people, place, and the environment.
profile.background: GLab Ent. is Guang’s Udyam-registered sole proprietorship. GLab is the public home for its technology projects and products, including GLabNetOps, as well as project documentation, technical articles, and personal learning notes. The work grows from networking and ISP operations experience and includes cybersecurity, software, community technology, environmental sustainability, and locally suitable farming interests.
